tasks.short: Teach diagnosis and management of genetic disorders

steps.what: Instruct students in genetic diagnosis and management, answering questions and correcting misconceptions

tasks.design: Keep clinical teaching interactive, supported by existing {DOCS} teaching material. The geneticist explains uncertainty and adapts instruction to questions and demonstrated understanding.
tasks.previous_blocker: Teaching quality depends on recognizing misconceptions as they emerge.
tasks.enabler_now: Document access is already available; no verified replacement for this interaction is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Students can repeat correct terms while misunderstanding diagnostic reasoning.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognizes unsafe reasoning and explains the judgement behind a clinical choice.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in teaching responsibility or assumed contact time.

reach.task: Explain a study's clinical implications to trainees
reach.learn: Teaching case design and assessment of understanding

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: interactive clinical instruction retains its human teaching time; no measured saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is delivery of instruction, not separately assigned course-material production or formal examination marking.
The geneticist selects and checks teaching cases during counted teaching preparation; students produce questions during instruction. No structured flag is presumed to establish competence.
Use native document and teaching tools before introducing custom support.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new automation or recurring workflow is introduced.
research_questions: Is any separately measured material-production overhead available without reducing teaching time?

already_counted.description: Instruction, questions and correction of misconceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Small-group cases and larger teaching sessions retain full human instruction; summaries are not credited as equivalent teaching.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Create and use genetic statistical models

steps.what: Specify statistical models, data definitions and checks for genetic analysis
Set parameters and run established genetic analysis routines
Assess model assumptions, investigate diagnostics and interpret genetic associations

tasks.design: Configure repeatable runs in {DATA_PLATFORM} from a scientist-authored manifest. Keep novel model creation, data suitability, diagnostics and scientific interpretation with the geneticist; automate only repetitive setup still done by hand.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated parameter entry and run setup interrupted analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned analysis pipelines can reuse explicit configurations and produce reproducible logs.
tasks.still_hard: Population structure, relatedness and causal interpretation need study-specific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist recognizes when a mathematically successful fit answers the wrong biological question.
tasks.altitude: More time can go to sensitivity analysis while model-choice authority remains unchanged.

reach.learn: Version control, dependency pinning and validation datasets

evidence.claim: nf-core provides versioned, containerized and tested bioinformatics pipelines; this supports repeatable execution, not automatic validity of a chosen statistical model.
Model knowledge: the setup-saving estimate is conditional on repetitive manual work being present.

assumptions: Boundary covers model specification, repeat run setup and interpretation, excluding sample processing and independent dataset production.

The geneticist produces and verifies the s1 manifest: dataset version, sample identifiers, variable mappings, exclusions, model family, parameters, software version, seed and diagnostic thresholds. Its capture time stays counted. Missing mappings or unsupported model families return to manual setup; scientific adequacy is never a machine flag.
Test existing analysis-platform job templates first; existing compute runtime receives no labour credit.
Eight incremental focal hours cover version updates, regression checks and failed-run configuration; other-role deployment effort is separately budgeted.
unknowns: How much run setup is already scripted
Available validated routines and data permissions
research_questions: Does manifest-driven execution remove manual setup while reproducing trusted results and preserving diagnostics?

incremental.description: Maintain run versions and regression checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B100 R75 gives25 gross minus8 focal upkeep =17 net. Already scripted runs or frequent novel models leave only0-4% conservative saving; machine runtime is excluded.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain laboratory safety and train staff

steps.what: Review laboratory hazards and maintain safety programs and procedures
Train personnel in laboratory safety techniques and assess practical understanding

tasks.design: Maintain the safety program in {DOCS} and teach the actual laboratory techniques in person. Preserve hazard review and observed practice rather than treating a completed reading record as competence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safety depends on local equipment, materials and actual staff practice.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document tools manage versions, but they do not establish safe technique.
tasks.still_hard: Rare hazardous situations and misunderstood instructions need direct assessment.
tasks.human_edge: The geneticist notices unsafe handling and can stop and correct it immediately.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in safety responsibility or training time.

reach.task: Explain laboratory hazards during a joint safety review

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: maintaining local safety procedures and assessing practical technique remain human work in this design.

assumptions: Boundary covers the geneticist's program maintenance and training, not all staff attendance or independent safety-officer work.
The geneticist checks hazards and captures procedure changes in s1 and observations in s2; all capture stays counted. No unexplained compliance or competence flag supplies a machine decision.
Inspect native document versioning and existing training records before building custom software.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new automation or extra reporting is proposed.
research_questions: Is there measured duplicate record entry outside the substantive safety and training work?

already_counted.description: Local safety review and program maintenance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Routine refreshers and changed hazards both retain human review and practical instruction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Develop protocols from genetic evidence, assay limitations and intended diagnostic uses

tasks.design: Keep diagnostic protocol development in {DOCS}, linking proposed changes to evidence and validation requirements. The geneticist decides which techniques are suitable; protocol drafting does not authorize clinical deployment.
tasks.previous_blocker: A usable protocol requires resolving assay-specific evidence and operational constraints.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned documents improve traceability without establishing a labour reduction in scientific development.
tasks.still_hard: Sensitivity, failure conditions and the consequences of false results require substantive validation.
tasks.human_edge: The geneticist anticipates where a technique could mislead clinical decisions.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in protocol-development responsibility or validation requirements.

reach.task: Specify acceptance evidence for an assay change
reach.learn: Validation design, traceability and failure-mode testing

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: diagnostic protocol development is scientific judgement; document generation alone does not establish a safe or faster protocol.

assumptions: Boundary ends at a proposed protocol and validation requirements; validation execution and clinical release have separate owners and are not assumed complete.

The geneticist examines existing evidence and records intended use, assay version, changes, limitations and required tests during fully counted s1. Missing evidence produces an unresolved validation requirement, never a fabricated pass result.
Use native document templates and version history before custom drafting tools.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new automated process or additional maintenance obligation is introduced.
unknowns: Nature and maturity of proposed techniques
research_questions: Can any separately measured formatting work be removed while retaining complete scientific development time?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Minor assay changes and novel diagnostic procedures both retain scientific design and unresolved validation work; formatting is not an invented baseline.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Repeat analysis setup may shrink; teaching, laboratory safety and diagnostic development retain their expert time.
reach: Define reproducible run contracts with bioinformatics colleagues
Help safety and quality colleagues specify evidence for laboratory changes
role.ambitious_version: A geneticist who combines reproducible computation with direct responsibility for scientific and clinical uncertainty.
